text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the April 24 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mikhail Chernoi, one of the biggest players on Russian aluminium market, rejects media allegations of milking the industry, saying in an interview that he helped Russian aluminium smelters survive during the critical 1992-96 period.
- Production of aluminium in Russia is so cost-ineffective that Russian producers could soon lose their competitive edge over Western suppliers, says aluminium expert Vladimir Kalchenko.
- Sergei Dubinin, head of the Central Bank, says barter deals in the economy breed high inflation.
- MRTA Marxist rebels in Peru lose the longest running match in their history, the paper says in a front-page story.
